meta.description: Every 5 minutes during teaching hours, asks Igor whether a lecture just ended without an answer. Igor pushes the 'derse girdin mi?' question to the watch when one has. Import into n8n, set the two credentials, activate.

nodes.name: Every 5 min, weekday teaching hours
nodes.notes:
*/5 6-19 * * 1-5 in the OWNER'S timezone — set n8n's generic timezone (or this workflow's Settings ▸ Timezone) to Europe/Istanbul, or this fires three hours off and every question arrives during a different lecture.

Weekdays only and 06:00–19:59 only: outside those hours there is no lecture to ask about, and each firing is a cheap DB query but not a free one.

nodes.name: Igor: ask-pending
nodes.notes:
window_minutes=20 must stay BELOW the watch's local fallback grace period (FallbackAskScheduler.GRACE_MINUTES = 15 + travel). If this window were the wider of the two, the watch would ask locally first and this push would arrive as a duplicate for an already-answered occurrence — harmless (the watch drops it) but noisy.

neverError: a 5xx from Igor must not mark the workflow failed and spam the error workflow every 5 minutes. The response is inspected below instead.

nodes.name: Question delivered?
nodes.notes: status is one of: idle (nothing ended — the common case), sent, no_devices, failed.

nodes.name: Log delivery
nodes.notes: Replace with a Telegram/Slack node if you want visibility while testing. Once it works this is noise — the watch buzzing is the notification.
